Fixed in `5ac3109`. Changed to responsive Tailwind breakpoints instead of hardcoding:

- `grid-cols-1` — narrow phones (< 640px)
- `sm:grid-cols-2` — larger phones / tablets (≥ 640px)
- `lg:grid-cols-3` — desktop (≥ 1024px)

The threshold is lowered from `md` (768px) to `sm` (640px) so more mobile devices benefit from 2-column layout, while narrow screens still gracefully fall back to 1 column.
